issue.title: sase bead note fast-path skips the write-sandbox guard (_MUTATING_VERBS omits note)
issue.description: Discovered while diagnosing epic sase-fb (bead_close_publication_loss.md, 'Adjacent issue found while diagnosing'). _MUTATING_VERBS in src/sase/main/bead_fast_path.py is {"+1", "close", "create", "open", "ref", "rm", "update"} and does not include "note", so _is_mutating_verb("note") is False and a 'sase bead note' fast-path run skips assert_bead_store_write_sandboxed (added by sase-9l.2's deny-by-default write guard) even though it writes an event and commits. This is a write-sandbox guard bypass specific to the note verb, not a cause of the bead-close publication loss sase-fb fixes. Fix: add "note" to _MUTATING_VERBS so the fast-path note verb is sandboxed identically to the other mutating verbs; add regression coverage that a sandboxed test run rejects an unguarded 'sase bead note' fast-path mutation the same way it already rejects close/create/etc.
